description: App windows (main, Descall+ pop-outs and account windows, admin windows): only the plugin calls the shims and Tauri's own drag region make. Events in, window buttons and dragging, links to the default browser (http, https, mailto: the scope of opener:allow-open-url, the same schemes as descall_shell::trust::is_safe_external_url; opener:allow-default-urls also allowed tel:), web notifications. No clipboard, shortcut, updater, deep-link, menu, tray or event emit from pages (the shell does those natively). App commands are limited per window in src/ipc_policy.rs. No remote origin is listed, so web pages never get IPC.
